ruleDefinitions.name: Inline Python Execution - Spawn Shell Via OS System Library
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of inline Python code via the "-c" in order to call the "system" function from the "os" library, and spawn a shell.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\/python$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/python2$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/python3$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\/python2\\\..*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\/python3\\\..*"))) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*os\\\.system\\(.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/bash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/dash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/fish.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/zsh.*"))))
